Pascal Siakam scored the Pacers' first basket more than anyone in 2025-26: 18 times in 62 starts, or 29% of the games they started. Andrew Nembhard was next with 14. The Pacers made the game's first field goal in 44% of their 82 games and won 49% of their opening tipoffs. Everything below is counted from the play-by-play of every 2025-26 game (1,225 regular season, 85 playoffs, 6 play-in).
